title: JANUS: Agentic Cross-Language Fuzzing Harness Generation for Android Native Libraries
abstract: arXiv:2610.30218v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern Android apps extensively rely on native libraries, bridging Java/Kotlin and C/C++ through the Java Native Interface (JNI). This cross-language interoperation, however, exposes the memory-safe Android Runtime to the unsafe C/C++ world, creating an attack surface that has been repeatedly exploited for full device compromise. While fuzzing is a proven technique for vetting native libraries, state-of-the-art harness generation tools struggle to faithfully capture closed-source cross-language API usage: (i) precise program analysis across the JNI boundary does not scale, whereas lightweight approximations miss critical invocation patterns; and (ii) none tackles the construction of complex composite objects consumed by JNI methods.   In this paper, we propose JANUS, the first agentic approach to synthesizing cross-language JNI-aware fuzzing harnesses for Android native libraries. translated_title: JANUS：面向Android原生库的智能体跨语言模糊测试驱动生成
translated_abstract: 现代Android应用大量依赖原生库，通过Java本地接口（JNI）桥接Java/Kotlin与C/C++。然而，这种跨语言互操作使内存安全的Android运行时暴露于不安全的C/C++世界，形成了一个被反复利用以实现设备完全攻陷的攻击面。虽然模糊测试是审查原生库的成熟技术，但最先进的测试驱动生成工具难以忠实地捕捉闭源跨语言API的使用：(i) 跨JNI边界的精确程序分析无法扩展，而轻量级近似方法则会遗漏关键的调用模式；(ii) 现有工具均无法解决JNI方法所消费的复杂复合对象的构造问题。在本文中，我们提出JANUS，这是首个采用智能体方法为Android原生库合成跨语言JNI感知模糊测试驱动的方案。JANUS迭代地解析显式和隐式的跨……
tldr: JANUS是首个采用智能体方法为Android原生库自动生成跨语言JNI感知模糊测试驱动的工具，解决了现有工具在跨JNI边界精确分析不可扩展、以及无法构造JNI方法所需的复杂复合对象这两大难题。
en_tdlr: JANUS is the first agentic approach for automatically generating cross-language JNI-aware fuzzing harnesses for Android native libraries, overcoming the scalability limits of precise cross-JNI-boundary analysis and the lack of support for constructing complex composite objects consumed by JNI methods.
